p06-ctx-t.name: p06-ctx-t

p06-ctx-t.text: **Used on this page**: $\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{p}+r\mathbf{n}$; the foot point $\mathbf{p}$ scores zero; $\mathbf{w}^T\mathbf{n}=\|\mathbf{w}\|$.

p06-fig-title.name: p06-fig-title

style.fontFamily: "Microsoft JhengHei", "Noto Sans CJK TC", "PingFang TC", "Segoe UI", sans-serif

p06-fig-title.text: Plug into the score: the foot-point term vanishes, leaving $r\|\mathbf{w}\|$

p06-c2-t.name: p06-c2-t

style.fontFamily: "Microsoft JhengHei", "Noto Sans CJK TC", "PingFang TC", "Segoe UI", sans-serif

p06-c2-t.text:
$g(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{w}^T\mathbf{p}+b+r\,\mathbf{w}^T\mathbf{w}/\|\mathbf{w}\|=0+r\|\mathbf{w}\|$
Signed distance $r=g/\|\mathbf{w}\|$; its absolute value is the geometric distance $z$; $\mathbf{x}=\mathbf{0}$ gives the origin distance $d$
Added: foot point $\mathbf{p}=\mathbf{x}-\frac{g}{\|\mathbf{w}\|^2}\mathbf{w}$, whose score should be zero
